briefdescription.para: Per-locality work queue with bounded reusable worker storage.

detaileddescription.para: Fields are handles into independent storage components. Queue claims hold a short lock; no queue lock spans communication or numerical work. A dispatch token rejects stale claims. Remote stealing transfers results to the owner.
